hooks.command: cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command | if type == "array" then join(" ") else (. // "") end'); echo "$cmd" | grep -qE 'git[[:space:]]+add[[:space:]]+([^|;&]*[[:space:]])?(-A|--all|-u|--update|\.)([[:space:]]|$)|git[[:space:]]+commit[[:space:]]+([^|;&]*[[:space:]])?(-a|--all|-am)([[:space:]]|$)' && { echo '27-version-control.md: stage the authorized change by explicit paths; bulk staging can sweep in uncommitted work from another session.' >&2; exit 2; }; exit 0
d=$(find . -type d -empty -not -path './.git/*' 2>/dev/null | git check-ignore -nv --stdin 2>/dev/null | grep '^::' | cut -f2); [ -n "$d" ] && echo "Empty directories (05-repo-layout.md): $d"; true
